title: verify@1: control verifies a pr-route story at ci through an independently rooted verifier dispatch

story.i_want_to: have a story that reaches ci on the pr route judged by a second runner session, and have control report, review and verify it under a verifier dispatch rooted apart from the implementer's
story.so_that: the merge precondition's custody check can pass at the head CI ran on without a human, and US-48.17's merge gate can ever answer allow

rationale: On the pr route the only custody act is the claim Placement makes (placement.ex:814, :1170-1186). start, report, request-review, review-complete and verify are never called, so Progress.merge_custody_status/1 (progress.ex:4011) can never be :ok and US-48.17 alone escalates every story at ci; HCB story ddb4fcc1 shows agent_status pending, reported_done_at null. Every implementer dispatch is already its own root (parent List.last([]) under the unlineaged operator :user key, placement.ex:1174), so a verifier minted the same way is root-separated by construction and the lineage ceiling holds. Verify also compares assigned_agent_id (progress.ex:4116), so the verifier must run on a different runner. A verify is not bound to a head today (merge_custody_status reads verified_status only) and validate_verifiable refuses a re-verify (progress.ex:4176), so a story verified at head X that returns to ci at Y would merge unverified. Sessions inherit the operator's MCP set (Mark's runner rule, 2026-09-16), which holds unlineaged legacy orchestrator and reviewer keys; reject is exempt from the empty-lineage refusal (progress.ex:4068), so once pr-route stories reach reported_done a session could reject a sibling story. Design brief: architect pass 2026-11-07, every claim checked against the cited lines.

acceptance_criteria.description: Registry holds verify@1 (archetype :judge, kind verify). Its candidates are stories at ci on a pr-mode source with a recorded head_sha whose verified_head_sha differs from it; the kind is in RunnerContract.Kinds, the runner_dispatches_kind CHECK and the runner contract (minor bump), and registry_test's bindings stay green.

Placing verify@1 mints dispatch B with the operator key as a new root, role :orchestrator, agent = a runner R2 whose agent id differs from the implementer runner's, and binds it through a new Progress.bind_verifier_dispatch/4 that locks the story, requires implementer_dispatch_id, fails closed on an empty lineage, a shared root or the same agent id, and writes verifier_dispatch_id with a chained verifier_selected audit entry in one transaction (sharing the write-and-audit half with assign_rotating_verifier/3). No eligible R2 escalates the story at ci naming no_independent_verifier_runner. B's key never reaches the session and is revoked once the verdict is applied.

The verify session reviews the PR diff at the recorded head against the story's acceptance criteria and answers an agent_result verdict (pass, or reject with findings). Control applies it in a job unique per (story, dispatch): pass runs Progress report, record_review and verify in that order with lineage and agent id read from B's row (each step skips when already done), then records stage effect verified_head_sha; reject sends the story ci -> implementing over a new control-only edge :verify_rejected carrying the findings. A runner's claimed -> implementing calls Progress.start_story/3 with the start cap the claim minted. No key the session holds is accepted by report, review or verify for this story.

The verify is bound to its head: a verdict whose head is not the stage row's current head_sha, or a story no longer at ci, is dropped and the drop recorded; verified_head_sha is head-keyed and cleared with head_sha; every head-clearing edge on a verified pr-route story calls a new Progress.invalidate_verification/3 in the same transaction (unverified, agent_status implementing, chained audit entry); MergePrecondition's custody fact requires verified_head_sha == the recorded head and otherwise refuses :verified_for_other_head.

Two custody holes this route opens are closed: Agents.Dispatcher's operator key query admits only keys no dispatch minted, and an unlineaged reject on a story whose stage row is on a pr-mode source is refused caller_lineage_required.

test_cases.name: a pass verdict leaves merge_custody_status :ok at the current head
steps: a story at ci on a pr-mode source, claimed under dispatch A on runner R
verify@1 is placed under root dispatch B on runner R2
R2 answers pass for the recorded head
expected_results: verified_status is :verified and verified_head_sha is the head

test_cases.name: a verdict for a moved head is dropped, and a moved head after verify invalidates it
steps: a pass verdict names head X while the stage row's head_sha is Y
separately, a verified story goes ci -> implementing over :base_moved
expected_results: the first leaves verified_status unchanged and records the drop
the second sets verified_status unverified and clears verified_head_sha

test_cases.name: one runner cannot verify its own work
steps: the only runner able to take verify@1 is the implementer's runner

test_cases.name: an unlineaged key cannot reject a pr-route story
steps: reject with a key no dispatch minted

technical_notes: Load .claude/skills/chain-of-custody/SKILL.md first. This story writes verifier_dispatch_id and reaches report, review-complete and verify; no role gate changes, control calls Progress with server-resolved lineage as Placement already does for claim. Fixers run on Opus; the epic PR needs /security-review.
Every pr-mode repository needs at least two runners with distinct agent ids; HCB has minis, ryzen and x1.
Candidate predicates must not overlap with US-48.17's merge job: verify@1 takes verified_head_sha != head_sha, the merge job takes verified_head_sha == head_sha.
